description: Hi everyone! I am a Computer Science student skilled in Python, C++, Java, and web development. For this challenge, I am building an interactive tool to explore and visualize Earth science and environmental data. I am participating solo to build a clean, impactful prototype. Looking forward to an amazing learning experience!
summary:
Earth Information Jukebox is an innovative, web-based multi-sensory tool designed to bridge the gap between complex climate science and human perception. Developed as a client-side static application using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and the Web Audio API, the project translates NASA GISS historical surface temperature anomaly data (1980–2026) into real-time audio frequencies, dynamic waveform visualizations, and interactive timeline telemetry.

It addresses the NASA Space Apps challenge by making climate data accessible through sound and vision, allowing users to audibly experience the rising temperature trends and critical heat anomalies. Requiring no external backend or API keys, it offers seamless interactivity, letting users inspect individual year telemetry, alter sound synthesis wave types, and adjust playback tempo. This empowers students, researchers, and visually impaired individuals to explore climate change data in an engaging, intuitive format.
